label: A CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustainer of all is present to all, from the contact principle
description: Let g sustain (CAUSE_OF_BEING_2) every other thing present at some moment of history v, and let x, other than g, be present at t. Since x is present at some moment, g sustains x, so g gives x being at t; by the contact principle g is present at t. Hence g is present, and giving x being, whenever x is. A short derivation from one open premise; with an originating cause in place of a sustaining one the conclusion fails (Control part 1), and without the contact principle it fails (part 2). No premise is established.
